candidates.change_summary: Change order so state update happens after logging (moves balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value to after the Log.AddMessage call).
Remove the balance increment so Deposit no longer updates balances.
Change the balance update to set balances[msg.sender] to msg.value instead of adding (resets previous balance).
Negate the require so it reverts when the usual non-overflow condition holds (require condition inverted).
Replace call to Log.AddMessage with sending Log.AddMessage to address(0) cast, causing different external call target (no-op/logging to zero address contract).
